items.summary: Firefly supported Lockheed Martin in two responsive space exercises for the U.S. Space Force as part of the VICTUS DIEM mission.

items.summary: Firefly is partnering with Kratos as a member of the MACH-TB 2.0 team to provide hypersonic test capabilities with our Alpha rocket.

items.summary: Addition of SciTec software and data processing capabilities expands Firefly’s responsive mission services for space and defense customers.

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Receives $10 Million NASA Contract Addendum for Blue Ghost Mission 1 Lunar Data

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Announces Pricing of Upsized Initial Public Offering

items.title: SSC and Firefly Progress Towards Orbital Launch from Esrange Following TSA Signing Between Sweden and the U.S.

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Announces New Lunar Imaging Service on its Elytra Spacecraft
items.summary: New Ocula imaging service offers high-resolution ultraviolet and visible spectrum imaging of the Moon from lunar orbit.

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Adds UAE’s Rashid 2 Rover to Blue Ghost Mission to the Far Side of the Moon

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Awarded AFRL Contract to Develop Ceramic Matrix Composite Rocket Engine Nozzle Extension

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Awarded DoD Contract for Responsive On-Orbit Mission with Elytra Spacecraft

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Ready to Launch Alpha FLTA006 for Lockheed Martin’s LM 400 Spacecraft No Earlier Than March 15

items.title: Firefly Aerospace Awarded $8.2 Million Texas Space Commission Grant to Expand Spacecraft Facility
